title: Auto Loans: can a same-day payoff be drawn from the borrower's checking ledger balance?
content:
# Auto Loans: can a same-day payoff be drawn from the borrower's checking ledger balance?

This rule of the Auto Loans product category at PCB applies when a borrower asks to pay an auto loan off today by a transfer from their own PCB checking account. It decides whether the payoff can be drawn at all, and so whether the amount posted is the payoff figure or 0.00.

## Clause

The transfer is drawn only from posted money of the borrower's checking account in active status. When that account's ledger balance is lower than the payoff amount, no payoff is posted and the amount is 0.00; otherwise the amount is the payoff amount.

## Condition, judgement, outcome (hypothetical payoff amount 12732.93)

| Ledger balance of the active checking account | Lower than the payoff amount? | Outcome |
|---|---|---|
| 12000.00 | yes | no payoff is posted; amount 0.00 |
| 12732.93 | no: equal | payoff posted for 12732.93 |
| 15000.00 | no | payoff posted for 12732.93 |

## Points of judgement

**Can a partial amount be drawn toward the payoff when the balance is short?** Not under this rule: when the ledger balance is lower than the payoff amount, no payoff is posted and the amount is 0.00.

**Which balance of the checking account is compared?** The ledger balance of the borrower's checking account in active status, meaning posted money.
